classification.difficultyReason: Applies exact ratios to right triangles, constructs an equilateral-triangle altitude and subtracts lengths found in nested triangles.

content.prompt: Find the exact value of $x$ in these diagrams.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with base 6, vertical right side x and a 60-degree top angle.
spec.mathematics: The side of length 6 is opposite the 60-degree angle; x is adjacent. The bottom-right angle is a right angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible.

spec.description: Equilateral triangle with all three sides labelled 4 and marked with single equal-length ticks. A double-headed vertical arrow to its right gives height x.
spec.mathematics: Every side is 4. The dimension arrow spans the base level to the apex level.
spec.answerVisibility: No altitude, half-base length or calculated height is supplied.

answer.worked:
Draw the altitude from the apex to the base. It bisects the base and forms two right triangles, each with hypotenuse $4$ and a $60^{\circ}$ base angle.
$$\begin{align*}\sin60^{\circ}&=\frac{x}{4}\\x&=4\times\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\x&=2\sqrt3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete equilateral triangle with a dashed altitude, right-angle mark, half-base lengths and one 60-degree base angle.
spec.mathematics: The altitude bisects a side of length 4 into lengths 2 and 2. In either half, sin60 degrees equals x/4.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; construction and derived labels are hidden in the student edition.

spec.description: Nested right triangles share base 9 and a vertical left side. The upper segment of the left side is x. At the right vertex, the base-to-inner-slope angle is 30 degrees and the angle between slopes is 15 degrees, labelled by an external leader.
spec.mathematics: The outer right triangle has a 45-degree angle at the right vertex. The required length is its height minus the inner triangle's height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; the derived 45-degree angle and heights are omitted.

answer.worked:
The angle between the base and the upper sloping side is $30^{\circ}+15^{\circ}=45^{\circ}$. Let $H$ be the whole vertical height and $h$ the lower vertical height.
$$\begin{align*}H&=9\tan45^{\circ}\\H&=9\\h&=9\tan30^{\circ}\\h&=\frac{9}{\sqrt3}=3\sqrt3\\x&=H-h\\x&=9-3\sqrt3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two right triangles share a vertical side of length 20. Their sloping sides meet the baseline at distinct points with angles 45 degrees and 30 degrees. A dimension arrow beneath the baseline marks the interval x between those points.
spec.mathematics: The inner baseline length is 20/tan45 degrees; the outer baseline length is 20/tan30 degrees. Their difference is x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible.

answer.worked:
Let $L$ be the whole baseline length and $l$ the shorter baseline length.
$$\begin{align*}\tan30^{\circ}&=\frac{20}{L}\\L&=\frac{20}{\tan30^{\circ}}=20\sqrt3\\\tan45^{\circ}&=\frac{20}{l}\\l&=\frac{20}{\tan45^{\circ}}=20\\x&=L-l\\x&=20\sqrt3-20\end{align*}$$
